newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares start up slightly ahead of US data.
newsitem.headline: French shares start up slightly ahead of US data.

text.p: French shares started slightly higher in a lacklustre market with investors awaiting the U.S. May jobs figures due in the afternoon.
* CAC-40 index up 13.11, or 0.49 percent, at 2,703.96 at 0813 GMT
* CAC-40 June futures 2,683 vs 2,685 at Thursday's close.
* GAN, up 0.17 percent at 117, said it had sold 1.5 million Total, which up 0.91 percent at 552, shares off-market.
